competitors.name: Instacart
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Instacart data showing protein and fiber searches and purchases gaining share in grocery trips. Searches containing 'protein' rose 12.7% in the first half of 2026, 'fiber' searches rose 26.4%, and protein is moving into center-store and frozen-adjacent items including Eggo Protein Waffles and Protein Pints ice cream.

competitors.name: Maya Kaimal
competitors.action: Maya Kaimal launched a widely available Chinese Indian cuisine line in the United States, including ready-to-eat fried rice and noodle items at Whole Foods Market and Sprouts nationwide plus stir-fry sauces at Sprouts. The products are positioned as clean-label, Non-GMO and free from preservatives and artificial flavors.

competitors.name: PepsiCo Siete Foods, Kraft Heinz Primal Kitchen, Chosen Foods
competitors.action: Food Dive reported Texas subpoenaed better-for-you brands as part of an investigation into avocado-oil claims after a UC Davis study found many processed foods labeled as made with avocado oil contained other oils. The probe increases scrutiny on premium ingredient and seed-oil-free positioning.

trends.topic: Protein and fiber claims expanding across grocery
trends.magnitude: Protein searches +12.7%; fiber searches +26.4% in H1 2026 on Instacart
trends.context: Functional nutrition claims are spreading beyond sports nutrition into center-store and frozen-adjacent products, reinforcing pressure for clear protein, fiber and ingredient communication.

trends.magnitude: Nationwide Whole Foods and Sprouts rollout
trends.context: Retailers are giving shelf space to more specific global cuisines, including Indo-Chinese flavors, rather than broad international-food positioning.

trends.magnitude: Texas subpoenas following UC Davis adulteration findings
trends.context: Premium oils and seed-oil-free claims are attracting regulatory and scientific scrutiny, raising proof requirements for better-for-you brands.
